ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 5:95 ratio of high-intensity (white/grey) to low-intensity (black) pixels across the ventral surface of the fluke.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominantly black contiguous field. Notable high-intensity circular pixel clusters are located in the medial-lateral regions of both lobes. Greyish-white pixel mottling is localized along the inner boundaries of the median notch and the proximal edges near the water line.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 44 degrees, extending into a narrow vertical fissure.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular saw-tooth topography. Individual peak-to-valley amplitudes range from 4 to 18 pixels, distributed continuously along the trailing boundary from the notch to the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: General convex curve fitted to the trailing edge of both lobes, transitioning into a pronounced upward sweep toward the distal extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Two primary high-contrast circular clusters detected: one roughly 35% across the left lobe and another 20% across the right lobe relative to the notch. Smaller, lower-contrast white spots are visible near the trailing edge of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A distinct, vertical high-intensity linear disruption approximately 25 pixels in length is visible on the far-left lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A significant irregular indentation or notch-like pixel loss is visible at the distal tip of the right lobe, indicating structural trauma or a healed amputation.
other_distinctive_markers: Exceptionally high-amplitude serration pattern across the entire trailing edge span, characterized by frequent, sharp jagged peaks.
